_README: F5 completeness attestation. The pipeline cannot know English phonotactics, so it verifies
that the transcription matches what the person who read the reference says it contains.
No expected inventory or count is hard-coded anywhere in this repository.
approval_note: Approved by the spec owner in the [CHATGPT HANDOFF - F5 implementation correction and source approval]. Claude did not set this flag on its own initiative.

reference.author: Kivisto-de Souza, Hanna
reference.title: Onset consonant clusters of General American English
reference.summarized_from_note: Table 1 states it is adapted/summarized from these three sources. Recorded verbatim as the provenance chain; Cruttenden describes SSBE but the table as published is General American, which the yod distribution confirms (no coronal+Y; SPY/SKY present, STY absent).

dialect_note: Matches the CMUdict lexicon (Section 9). Verified mechanically: no coronal+Y onset appears, while labial and velar yod survives - GA yod-dropping after coronals.
notes: Concatenated forms in the handoff were expanded to space-separated ARPAbet by longest-match parse; every expansion was verified unambiguous.
